page_title: CAG 3-2 ATA | Cagliari v Atalanta 27/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Juan Luca Sacchi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+6' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
90+3' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

90+2' Atalanta are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
89' The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.

89' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Elia Caprile shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
85' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari have a free kick.
84' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

83' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
82' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

82' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Elia Caprile blocks the shot with his legs. Atalanta win a corner.
79' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) makes a strong challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
77' Gennaro Borrelli has picked up an injury and is replaced by Andrea Belotti (Cagliari).
77' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere makes way for Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
75' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
74' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
73' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Marten de Roon will be replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sead Kolasinac walks off the pitch to be replaced by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta).
73' Juan Rodriguez is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pisacane sends Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) on the pitch.
72' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
68' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
67' Atalanta keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
66' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
65' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.

63' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

61' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game. One of the players from Atalanta won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
60' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
59' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
56' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta makes his way off the pitch and Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
56' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) replacing Raoul Bellanova.
56' Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Marco Palestra (Cagliari).
56' Here is a change. Alessandro Deiola is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).

54' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
54' Adam Obert (Cagliari) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' The resulting corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
53' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
52' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game. One of the players from Atalanta won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cagliari.
52' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' 3 - 2 Goal! Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:2.

47' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Marco Carnesecchi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Pisacane decided to make a change. Paul Mendy (Cagliari) is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The game is interrupted now, Paul Mendy (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+4' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
45+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
45+1' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 2 Goal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Giorgio Scalvini, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 2:2.
45' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Atalanta.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' 2 - 1 Goal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:1.
38' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

37' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
36' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Cagliari earn a free kick.
34' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
33' One of the players from Atalanta times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
28' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.

27' It looks like Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) saw red with that tackle. Juan Luca Sacchi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
26' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
25' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Atalanta.
24' A clumsy foul by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. Cagliari are awarded the free kick.

23' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
22' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Atalanta are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
21' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
20' Adam Obert (Cagliari) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

18' The cross into the penalty area from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
17' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick.
16' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.
15' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Cagliari have been awarded a free kick.
12' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
8' 2 - 0 Goal! Paul Mendy (Cagliari) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Marco Carnesecchi. He makes it 2:0.

8' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a decent save and thwarts the effort.
8' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Paul Mendy (Cagliari) heads on.
4' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

1' 1 - 0 Michel Adopo sends a superb cross into the box. Paul Mendy (Cagliari) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Marco Carnesecchi beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
